script_text: Stop! Aries, the celestial gears are grinding in a way that demands your undivided attention this March 17. Mars, your fiery ruling planet, is transiting your 2nd House of Finances and forming a tense square to Neptune in your 12th House of Secrets. This aspect clouds monetary judgments with illusion, urging you to verify every detail. In love, Venus in your 11th House of Friends sextiles your Ascendant, amplifying your charm in group settings. If single, you'll attract intellectually stimulating partners; if taken, navigate power dynamics as Pluto opposes your 7th House. Career-wise, Jupiter's trine to Mars from your 5th House of Creativity promises lucrative opportunities from hobbies, but avoid speculative risks. An unexpected blessing arrives through intuitive flashes—trust them. Follow for tomorrow's reading to harness this cosmic momentum.
